blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — The national government has resumed distributing educational financial aid to decommissioned Moro rebels and their dependents as part of the implementation of the peace agreement between the Government of the Philippines (GPH) and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF). MILF decommissioned combatants (DCs) and their next of kin enrolled in the government’s Educational Assistance Program (EAP) have been receiving their allowances since Oct. 1, according to the GPH-MILF Task Force for Decommissioned Combatants and their Communities (TFDCC). Of the 1,028 approved grantees in the program’s first batch, 303 have already received their full P50,000 grant, which covers tuition, […]...
